eventScripts.script:
#generate random faults
	import random
	lineCount = 7
	tagPaths = ["[.]../Line %d/Plc/State" %line for line in range(1,lineCount+1) ]
	tagPaths.extend("[.]../Line %d/Plc/ProductionCounter" %line for line in range(1,lineCount+1))
	tagValues = system.tag.readBlocking(tagPaths)
	for i in range(7):
		
		if tagValues[i].value == 1:
			
			#increment production
			system.tag.writeAsync("[.]../Line %d/Plc/ProductionCounter" %(i+1), tagValues[i+lineCount].value+1)
			#increment reject
			if random.randint(1,10*(i+1)) in [9]:
				system.tag.writeAsync("[.]../Line %d/Plc/RejectCounter" %(i+1), system.tag.readBlocking(["[.]../Line %d/Plc/RejectCounter" %(i+1)] )[0].value+1)
